title: Idle Arcade Restaurant Tycoon Game
summary: In this project, I implemented responsive controls for intuitive player interactions, enabling smooth movement for managing customer orders and kitchen tasks. Focused on optimization, ensuring seamless performance across devices, even in complex gameplay scenarios.

description.overview: An engaging idle restaurant management game where players build and expand their culinary empire. From simple food stalls to multi-story restaurants, manage every aspect of the business while earning profits even when offline.
technicalHighlights: Efficient AI systems for staff and customers
challenges: Balancing idle progression with active gameplay
